verdict.line: You lose if you walk up into Q (Infected Cleaver) poke and let him stack Masochism auto trades; you win if you blind every all-in and starve his Adrenaline Rush sustain with grievous wounds.

brief.thesis: Mundo's whole kit is health-percent damage and self-healing with zero hard CC, so Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) completely cancels his only source of burst — the E (Masochism)-empowered auto. The matchup is decided by whether you can land that blind before he commits to a trade, which is exactly why the measured numbers favor you: 52.5% over 244 games with both lane and solo-kill edge.

theirWindow.when: Masochism active and he's walking at you
theirWindow.what: His next auto hits much harder off the missing-health AD scaling. Don't trade face to face into this — kite with E (Toxic Shot) poke or disengage until the buff window passes.

yourWindow.when: He commits to melee range to auto you
yourWindow.what: Land Q (Blinding Dart) the instant he's in his 325-range Burning Agony (W) aura or about to auto. The 8s cooldown blind removes his damage entirely for its duration, letting you free-hit with E (Toxic Shot) stacks.

powerCurve.note: Q blind punishes early trades hard
Adrenaline Rush regen starts matching poke

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Doran's Ring is run in 70.6% of games here (52% win rate over 221 games) — the extra sustain and mana let you throw Q (Blinding Dart) on cooldown without drying up against his regen.

boots.why: Picked in 47% of games (48.2% win rate) — Mundo has no magic resist itemization early, so the flat penetration converts your E (Toxic Shot) poison ticks into real pressure.

core.why: First item in the 35.7%-picked path (58.7% win rate) — the proc damage and movement speed let you kite his melee range while stacking poison.
Second in that same core path — burn damage on top of your poison overwhelms his percent-health regen from Adrenaline Rush.
Closes out the 58.7%-winrate path — the ability haste means more Q blinds and more Noxious Trap (R) coverage over the course of a fight.

situational.when: his Adrenaline Rush healing is keeping him alive through your poke
he starts building health stacking and you need the execute-style bonus against high-HP targets
you'd rather guarantee you can always kite his auto range than buy raw penetration

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking vulnerability from autos pairs with E (Toxic Shot) to punish every trade window you open with Q (Blinding Dart) blinding him first.

summoners.why: Run in 92.6% of games at 52.7% win rate — Ignite applies grievous wounds that directly cuts Adrenaline Rush healing, which is the single biggest lever in this matchup per OP.GG's own tip.

playing.title: Blind before he commits
playing.detail: Q (Blinding Dart) has an 8s cooldown and 680 range — use it the moment he walks up to auto, not after he's already hit you. This removes his Masochism (E)-buffed damage entirely for the duration.

playing.title: Never auto-trade in his Burning Agony range
playing.detail: W (Burning Agony) has only a 1s cooldown and hits all nearby enemies within 325 range continuously — step out the instant you see the drain visual rather than trying to out-sustain it.

playing.title: Poke with E, don't all-in
playing.detail: E (Toxic Shot) has 0 cooldown and applies on every attack, so stay at your 680 auto range and kite rather than committing to full trades he can heal through.

playing.title: Buy grievous wounds early if he's healing through poke
playing.detail: Pick up Oblivion Orb components ahead of schedule the moment Adrenaline Rush starts outpacing your damage — this is the counterplay OP.GG's data explicitly calls out.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Sadism
playing.detail: Dr. Mundo's R (Sadism) has a 75s cooldown and grants him a health-regen and speed burst — don't chase him under turret once he pops it, since you can't out-trade the sustain.

playing.title: Press your early levels
playing.detail: Levels 1-6 are your strongest window per the power curve — look to zone him off CS and land free Q blinds before his HP-scaling damage catches up around level 12+.

playing.title: Use Move Quick to disengage, not engage
playing.detail: W (Move Quick) builds passive movement speed until struck — use the window before he closes distance to reposition for poke rather than trying to stick on him in melee.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reasoning on cooldowns, trade windows, and ability interactions is this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Use Blinding Darts [Q] to block Dr. Mundo’s Masochism (E) reinforced basic attacks. Purchase items that reduce healing first.
